construction.fixed_sigma: one fixed B0 coarse source class sigma
construction.vertices: S_sigma plus one quotient vertex [C] for each connected component C of residual G[Y0]
construction.component_edges: no edges between distinct quotient component vertices
construction.cross_edges: v-[C] iff v is complete to C

theorem_target: For every k>=1, every induced P_k in Q_sigma lifts to an induced P_k in G by replacing each [C] with an arbitrary representative c in C.
corollary: If G is P7-free, then Q_sigma is P7-free.
acceptance: preserve survivor-survivor edges and nonedges exactly
preserve survivor-component edges and nonedges using B0 complete/anticomplete uniformity
exclude component-component chords because distinct Y0 components are anticomplete
cover arbitrary path orientation and arbitrary k
firewalls: Q_sigma P7-free does not imply bounded mim-width or sim-width.
Q_sigma P7-free does not yield a polynomial 4-colouring algorithm.
No B1B1 common-layout claim follows from this theorem alone.
